data.name: Nithinraj
data.gender_notes: Nithinraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nithi means 'day' and raj means 'rule' or 'grace'. The name Nithinraj signifies the grace of God that is present every day. The name Nithinraj carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nithinraj usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nithinraj belongs to the Tamil linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nithinraj total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
